title: Live-Action Sakamoto Days Film Opens in Hong Kong on September 17
content: Hong Kong film distributor Neofilms announced last Friday that it will open the live-action film of Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga in Hong Kong on September 17. The film opened in Japan on April 29, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend.
author: ANN

title: Creepy Nuts Make Guest Appearances in The Weeknd's Asian Tour Leg
content: Japanese hip-hop duo Creepy Nuts announced on June 3 that they will be special guests for some concerts on the Asian leg of singer-songwriter The Weeknd's long-running After Hours Til Dawn tour. In Southeast Asia, Creepy Nuts will guest on the concerts in Singapore; Bangkok, Thailand; and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

title: Burnout Syndromes Band Holds Concert in Manila on September 5
content: The Burnout Syndromes band announced on July 20 that it will hold a concert in Quezon City, Metro Manila on September 5. The concert will take place at The Crossroad Center near Timog. Burnout Syndromes performed the opening themes for three seasons of the Haikyu!!

title: The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie Opens in Indonesia in September
content: Indonesian cinema chains CGV Cinemas and Cinépolis Indonesia announced last Friday that they will both open The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie , the compilation film of the television anime of Norio Sakurai 's The Dangers in My Heart ( Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu ) manga, in Indonesia in September.

title: Muse Asia Licenses The World's Strongest Witch, Firefly Wedding Anime
content: Muse Asia announced on Friday and Saturday that it has licensed The World's Strongest Witch anime and the Firefly Wedding anime. Muse Asia will announce streaming details for the anime at a later date.
author: ANN

title: Odex Opens Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway Film in Singapore on September 5
content: Odex announced last Thursday that its screening of Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi ( Detective Conan : Fallen Angel of the Highway ), the franchise 's 29th film , in Singapore will open on September 5. The film will screen exclusively in Golden Village cinemas. The film opened in Japan on April 10.
